knownConflicts.summary: The approved Phase A package must not be mutated to carry Phase B candidate state.
The component-pantry comparison described breadth and reuse; it did not request a searchable planning product.
Round 01 proved functional breadth but compressed too much approved Phase A expression into one repeated rectangle.
Round 02 incorrectly rendered the 32 approved Phase A applications as a second review gallery beside the functional work.
The Round 04 bento must be a conventional premium grid made from complete Phase A-derived cards, with meaningful hierarchy and at most one live field.
The canonical registry has no production offer or price authority; all SaaS and digital-product commerce examples remain illustrative fixtures.
The six local integration images are review fixtures owned by their trademark holders; their presence grants neither production nor redistribution authority.
Product Family and Commerce 01 approved behavior but not visual execution or historical product data.

stopConditions: Do not edit the approved Phase A contract, package, review or feedback evidence.
Do not render the 32 approved Phase A inputs as a duplicate Round 04 review gallery.
Do not restore the killed B-FT04 or B-FT06 workflows.
Do not replace actual functional specimens with planning cards, catalogue metadata or a searchable inventory interface.
Do not treat illustrative prices, tiers, bundles, tax or checkout state as production authority.
Do not include payment-provider secrets, endpoints, network calls or tax logic in components.
Do not build decorative bento cells or allocate multiple live cores.
Do not fabricate integration marks or treat locally sourced review assets as trademark, redistribution or production authority.
Do not hardcode a five-product limit or hide essential mobile content behind swipe-only access.
Do not enter the golden homepage, generic application UI, Figma, channels or consumer migration.

humanNotes: Olli used an ultimate component pantry as an analogy for breadth, adaptability and future reuse—not as a request for a searchable planning interface.
Phase A is the approved visual construction grammar beneath Phase B. Its 32 keeps remain inputs and do not render as additional Round 04 review candidates.
The exact Round 03 receipt hash is 0ebc1bc12d4a41d0ec66aed163f130aa625db9615e09e24479f52fed1c7d566c and records 11 keeps, 35 revisions and the B-FT06 kill across 47 functional candidates.
PB2 Round 04 carried the 11 champions forward, rebuilt the 35 revisions, removed B-FT04 and B-FT06, and received keep for all 46 functional specimens.

Round 04 specifically proves equal DS05 and PR10 geometry, a four-card one-live bento, six locally sourced integration images, an explicit Phase A card in before-and-after explanation and default-live waitlist material.

Live Round 04 proof covers mounted scope, representative interaction, motion handoff and exact-static behavior. Exhaustive consumer-specific container, viewport, zoom, keyboard, content-stress and recovery proof remains explicit downstream work.
Olli closed H-EXP-04B-CARD-FUNCTIONAL-PROOF on 22 July 2026; DEC-PRODUCT-COMPONENT-SYSTEM-001 records bounded canonical authority while consumer-specific stress proof remains follow-up.
